scope: Proposition 6.11 (Recovery of the original panel observations) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The family (Pz)z∈BS commutes on the original start space, and the family (Qz)z∈BS commutes on the original end space. There is a homogeneous analytic homeomorphism τ : BS → BT and measurable target projectivity observations a, b on their respective spectra such that these families are evaluations of (6.16) z 7−→ aτ(z), z 7−→ bτ(z). In the independent input tensor product, the output projectivity is sharp and equals ab−1: (6.17) E(W)J = J 1W (ab−1 ) for every Borel W ⊂ T. The assertions hold coordinatewise on many-panel links.
